description: billcall's one hook. At session start, when the company has set a budget (max_usd_per_day or max_usd_per_month in company-ai-policy.json, or ~/.billcall/budget.json), it says in one line how much of it Claude Code on this computer has spent today and this month at list price - from 50% of the budget on, and again at 80% and 100%. With no budget, or below half of it, it says nothing. It goes through the step 0 guard in quiet mode: with no Python it says nothing either, and the session goes on.

hooks.command:
exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/python.sh" billcall quiet "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/billcall/scripts/billcall.py" guard --hook
trap { continue }; & ([scriptblock]::Create((Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/python.ps1"))) billcall quiet "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/billcall/scripts/billcall.py" guard --hook
